days.title: Glacial Highlands and Historical Markers
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Skógarheiði
stops.detail: To the north, the Fimmvörðuháls borders on Þórsmörk, to the south on Skógarheiði.

stops.name: Wanderweg von Skógar nach Þórsmörk
stops.detail: A well-known hiking trail leads over the Fimmvörðuháls from Skógar to Þórsmörk.

stops.name: fünf dicht beisammenstehenden Steinmännern
stops.detail: There it is described that, although the frequently used path over the pass between the glaciers was very popular, its marking left much to be desired, apart from the five closely spaced cairns on the summit of the pass.

days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Hrunagil
stops.detail: A lava flow ran into the Hrunagil gorge.

stops.name: Hvannárgil
stops.detail: The lava flowed away in the direction of the Hvannárgil gorge.

stops.name: Magni
stops.detail: The two volcanic cones were given the names Magni (82 m height) and Móði (47 m height), after two sons of the god Thor.
